recipe.visualDefinition: A split-composition graphic featuring a top horizontal band of five monochromatic, sepia-toned human portraits above a large surrealist landscape dominated by a white dove flying over a grid of stylized, orange-rimmed clouds under a purple sky.
coreVisualRelationships: The dove acts as a central dynamic bridge between the geometric cloud grid and the static portraits.
The contrast between the realistic, desaturated portraits and the vibrant, saturated surreal landscape.
The rhythmic repetition of the cloud shapes creating a forced perspective toward the horizon.
coreInvariants: Horizontal division at the upper third
Grid-based cloud formation with dark undersides
Monochromatic portrait gallery at the top edge

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large white dove is centered, angled diagonally, occupying the middle two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dove's body serves as the primary anchor, supported by the repetitive cloud grid below.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the portraits, moves down to the text, follows the dove's wing span, and settles into the receding cloud grid.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The purple sky provides breathing room around the dove and separates it from the top portrait band.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted purple and dusty rose for the sky and atmosphere.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep orange and black for the cloud grid highlights and shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Off-white for the dove and sepia-tones for the portraits.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the landscape elements (orange/purple) contrasts with the low-saturation, high-value portraits at the top.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earthy oranges and muted purples

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for both artist name and title with slight scale variations.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, tight, geometric feel of the era's display type.
Provides the clean, mid-century modern aesthetic seen in the layout.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a surreal landscape with a large white dove in flight over a grid of orange-rimmed clouds. The sky is a muted purple. At the top, include a horizontal band containing five sepia-toned, 1970s-style portraits of people.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add centered, bold, condensed sans-serif text in all caps. Place the artist name at the very top center and the title in three stacked lines just above the dove.

verificationChecks: Is the portrait band strictly at the top?
Does the cloud grid show forced perspective?
Is the dove the largest element in the landscape?
Is the text centered and condensed?

adjustableVariables: Number of portraits in the top band
Intensity of the purple sky color
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the portraits
Any specific logos in the corners

mustAchieve: Geometric regularity in the cloud field

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the portraits are monochromatic sepia.
Check that the cloud grid recedes toward a horizon line.
Verify the dove has a soft, airbrushed appearance.
Confirm the text is centered and uses a bold sans-serif.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Sepia Portrait Band] + [Surreal Landscape with Central Animal] + [Geometric Repetitive Ground Plane] + [Centered Condensed Sans-Serif Typography].
